injuries.name: Austen Pleasants
injuries.note: Pleasants (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against Seattle.

injuries.name: Dre Greenlaw
injuries.note: Greenlaw (neck) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Seahawks.

injuries.name: Jordan Watkins
injuries.note: Watkins (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injuries.name: Mike Evans
injuries.note: Evans (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest against the Seahawks, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

injuries.name: Brock Purdy
injuries.note: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that Purdy (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Seahawks, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

injuries.name: Colton McKivitz
injuries.note: McKivitz (ankle) was placed on the 49ers' injured reserve list Wednesday.

injuries.name: Sam Okuayinonu
injuries.note: Okuayinonu (foot) was spotted walking without a limp in the 49ers' locker room Wednesday, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injuries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
injuries.note: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that Stribling (ankle) is likely at least "a couple weeks away" from returning to practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. "I don't know. I mean, nothing's changed," Shanahan said, regarding a timeline for the rookie receiver.

injuries.name: Jarran Reed
injuries.note: Reed (toe) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

injuries.name: Quenton Nelson
injuries.note: Head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Wednesday that Nelson (knee) will not play against the 49ers on Sunday, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Abraham Lucas
injuries.note: Lucas (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: George Holani
injuries.note: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
